title: Psalm emits this issue when a class implements an interface method but a param type is more specific than the interface method param type.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 6 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when the declared return type for a method is more specific than the inferred one (emitted in the same methods that LessSpecificReturnStatement is).
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 4 and higher.
